intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and both have a postgraduate media programme on this page. We compare recorded {{course}} fees and 2023 placements from our database, and we point to official sites we opened in {{year}}.

Institute of Science Poona's College of Computer Science vs MIT Pune is mainly a fee contrast. The two degrees also have different names, so check the exact award before you treat them as interchangeable.

sections.heading: Institute of Science Poona vs MIT Pune for Mass Communication (PG): which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MIT Pune if you want the recorded Master of Arts in Mass Communication and can budget for the higher year fee, with a 2023 average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh.

Choose the Institute of Science Poona programme if you want the Master of Journalism and Mass Communication at a much lower recorded tuition, and you accept a 2023 average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For the Institute of Science Poona course we hold ₹30,000 as tuition for one year, plus smaller heads such as development, computer, library and other fees. A ₹500 university-fee row is also present; do not quote that as the programme fee.
For MIT Pune we hold ₹2,72,250 as a Total Fees year figure for the Master of Arts in Mass Communication. That is a year amount in our table, not a confirmed two-year official total.
The fee gap is large, so recheck both official notices on ccspune.in and mitpune.com before you decide. We did not invent a two-year total by doubling either year figure.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a 2023 placement row. The Institute of Science Poona journalism master's is recorded at ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest. MIT Pune's MA is recorded at ₹5 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest.
These are historical records for 2023, not a promise for 2026. The gap is modest compared with the fee gap, so ask both placement cells for the latest report if outcomes are your main test.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither programme has an entrance exam mapped on this page. Follow the official admissions note for eligibility, application dates and any institute test or interview.

The awards differ in name: a Master of Journalism and Mass Communication on one side, and a Master of Arts in Mass Communication on the other. Confirm which degree title you need for further study or jobs.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Pune, so you can visit them on the same trip and compare studios, labs and the daily commute from your part of the city.
MIT Pune is a large multi-discipline campus. The Institute of Science Poona college is a smaller specialist setting. That changes class size and the peer group as much as the fee does.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick MIT Pune if you prefer the recorded 2023 package of ₹5 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest and can pay the much higher recorded year fee of ₹2.72 lakh.
Pick the Institute of Science Poona course if the lower recorded tuition of ₹30,000 a year is the deciding factor and the 2023 average of ₹4 lakh is acceptable.
Because the degree titles differ, do not assume one award will substitute for the other in every job or Ph.D application.

faqs.question: Is the Institute of Science Poona media fee only ₹500?
faqs.answer: No. The ₹500 row is a university fee, not tuition. Recorded tuition for the Master of Journalism and Mass Communication is ₹30,000 a year, plus smaller development, computer and library heads.

faqs.question: What fee is on record for MIT Pune's MA in Mass Communication?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹2,72,250 as a Total Fees year figure. That is not a confirmed two-year official total. Check the current notice on the MIT Pune site before you budget.

faqs.question: How do the 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: For 2023 we record ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest at the Institute of Science Poona programme, and ₹5 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest at MIT Pune. These are historical figures, not promises.

faqs.question: Are the two postgraduate media degrees the same?
faqs.answer: Not in name. One is a Master of Journalism and Mass Communication; the other is a Master of Arts in Mass Communication. Confirm the award title if you need it for a job or further study.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is required?
faqs.answer: This page has no exam mapped for either programme. Use the official admissions pages for eligibility, any institute test, and application dates.

faqs.question: Are both colleges in Pune?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Pune, Maharashtra, so you can visit the campuses on the same trip and compare facilities and travel time.
